correctness.rationale: Exact reduction from Lin et al. equations (1),(4),(7),(16) yields a normalized positive ratio. Bernoulli KL strict convexity gives f(0)=f′(0)=0, f′(1)=1 and 0<rho<1. A factored derivative proves the ideal monotonicity and eventually decreasing housekeeping threshold, with compact positivity forcing the unique global small-cost maximum. Tail expansions establish the sharp logarithmic location and efficiency loss. The linear-response threshold is globally decreasing because 4-e^s-(3+2s)e^(-s)<0 for every s>0, with a unique finite maximum. The full-domain analytical proof is supplemented by 458 deterministic checks in verify.py; no finite test is treated as proof of an infinite statement.

The new exact logarithmic clock and h log(1/h) best-efficiency penalty specify an operational stopping law in all finite-affinity two-state batteries; its coefficient depends only on the measurable ideal efficiency rho. The all-housekeeping linear-response curve proves a strict and continuous transition from near-ideal slow charging to maximum-power timing.
